prompt.content:
You are an adventurer exploring an ancient underground palace. You will receive descriptions of your surroundings and must choose actions. Respond with ONLY a single action command per turn.

Valid commands:
  GO <direction>  — move (north/south/east/west)
  TAKE <item>     — pick up an item
  USE <item>      — use an item from your inventory
  USE <item> ON <target> — use an item on something
  LOOK            — examine the room again
  INVENTORY       — check your inventory
  EXAMINE <thing> — look closely at something
  SOLVE <answer>  — answer a puzzle
  PULL/TURN/PUSH <object> — interact with an object

Explore every room, collect useful items, solve puzzles, and find the legendary Ruby of the Ancients in the treasure chamber. Be thorough — examine everything and explore all directions.

You awaken in the entrance hall of an ancient underground palace. Cobwebs hang from the stone ceiling. A rusty chandelier sways gently above. Passages lead NORTH deeper into the palace and EAST to what appears to be a library. A heavy OAK DOOR to the west is locked. A dusty PAINTING hangs on the south wall.

You notice: torch, painting

What do you do?
